radialCoverage.rule: g = 1 when hypot(sampleCenterCss - projectedCenterCss) <= diameterCssPixels / 2; otherwise g = 0
radialCoverage.antiAliasing: no fractional geometric edge in version 1

sampling.renderSize: max(1, floor(cssExtent * devicePixelRatio * renderScale + 0.5)) per axis
sampling.sizeClamp: use an equivalent quad or report unsupported; never hidden native clamp

materialComposition: 01-domain-rendering section 4.2; geometry and material evaluated separately; unsupported edge/material policies never silently fallback
ditherRuleBinding: A separately ratified immutable G0 dither rule must bind matrix, seed derivation and top-left sample coordinates to the two distinct domains. A dither request is unsupported until that exact rule ID/digest and required capability are available; no engine defaults.
